svg.title: Serenity UAV build guide 15 - VOID FORMERS AND CONDUITS

svg.text: SERENITY-CLASS TILTROTOR UAV · BUILD GUIDE · REV T+
Everything that must stay hollow goes in before the pour
Seat the three cargo void formers; check that none rocks against the shell wall.
Cap the spar passages (card 07) and keep the gear-bay pockets clear.
Run every conduit with a pull string accessible at both ends.
Full dry fit with all wiring before mixing any foam.
The foam pour is the point of no return. Anything left out now cannot be added later.
The collar_rim and batt_chimney formers are obsolete: their collar and battery cradle were retired with the one-piece forward
